name: cmux-spinoff
description: Fork the current thread of work into its own place: takes the topic/plan/idea just discussed and moves it into a fresh git worktree with a new, already-briefed Claude session in a new cmux tab — so the current session stays focused and the new one picks up the context. Command-invoked only via /start. Branches a worktree (from current HEAD or develop), writes a handoff doc linking back to the originating session's transcript, carries over recent plan/brainstorm docs, opens a new tab on the left-hand agent surface of the current cmux workspace, and boots a briefed Claude there.
